partial.name: glPixelTransferi
partial.limitation: Exact GLint bits reach native GL; Linux Mesa26.1.8 INDEX_OFFSET at INT_MAX reads back INT_MIN through native float conversion. Extreme-range state correctness remains unresolved; no fabricated shadow state.

partial.name: glDrawPixels
partial.limitation: One immutable native draw and exact unpack/transfer semantics implemented. Linux Mesa negative fractional pixel zoom misses three pixels in the retained oracle, independently reproduced through direct EGL without DreamGPU; this native rasterization limitation remains unresolved.

partial.name: glCopyTexImage1D
partial.limitation: Full GL1.1 base/sized formats and border0/1 are forwarded to the actual native API. Linux Mesa silently drops a requested border: width6/border1 becomes native width4/border0 with no GL error, reproduced through direct EGL; Mac exact border pixels pass. Native width is recorded honestly; no fabricated border state.

partial.name: glCopyTexSubImage1D
partial.limitation: Copies validate the actual native level width/border before submission. Linux Mesa drops borders when CopyTexImage1D defines the source level, so border texel copies remain unavailable there; borderless copies use the actual native API. Mac bordered copies pass.
